notes.title: 📢 Demo Update + Publisher Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello comrades,

We have two important updates to share with you:


🤝 We have a Publisher!
 We’re very excited to announce that Kriophobia will be published by indie.io. This partnership will allow us to bring more quality to our game and, beyond that, reach many more players around the world.


🎮 Demo Update
 The Kriophobia demo has been updated! While there are no major changes, we’ve made several minor adjustments and bug fixes to make the experience smoother than ever.


If there’s something you’d like to see fixed but haven’t yet, please let us know.

This is a huge milestone for the project, and we want to thank everyone who has been supporting us from the very beginning.


👉 Play the new demo, share your feedback in the comments, and don’t forget to add Kriophobia to your wishlist!


See you in the frozen lands of Siberia, where the cold is deadly.

notes.title: First Kriophobia Demo Update – Multiple Fixes and a New Platform
notes.notes:
Hello, comrades!   

Based on your feedback and from the events where we’ve showcased the Kriophobia demo, we’ve developed a patch that brings several fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and, for the first time, Mac support.



Here’s a list of the main updates:

🍎 You can now play the Kriophobia demo on your Mac.

🕹️ We’ve added a video that showcases the Tank and Modern control styles. You’ll choose your preferred style at the beginning of the game.

🎨 We've added color blindness accessibility features.

🔨 We’ve also implemented a series of bug fixes and general adjustments, such as improved demo flow, better UI feedback for game and enemy states, enhancements to relative camera input, updated credits, and more.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347121/af19630ee484cb4300d4d03f088883d0eaa4dcde.gif"]

See you in the frozen lands of Siberia, where the cold is deadly.

- Fira Soft Team
